summary: Migrated the 5 PMCRO lifecycle roles (orchestrator, planner, maker, checker, reflector) from separate plugins/pmcro-*/skills/*/SKILL.md files into the new pmcro/agents/*.md single-file convention with output_schema frontmatter, per PLAN-three-package-architecture.md. All content migrated verbatim from existing SKILL.md workflow/constraint text, not fabricated. Independently re-verified: 5 schemas parse as JSON, 5 agent frontmatter blocks parse as YAML with required keys, mayNot lists match source. Original plugins/pmcro-* directories left untouched pending open-question resolution on cutover.
earned_constraints: When migrating a role convention (multi-file plugin -> single-file agent), verify by independently re-parsing the new artifacts in a fresh process rather than trusting the write call succeeding - a successful write is not equivalent to a structurally valid result.

This repo had a stale active_trail_id.txt pointing at an orphaned trail (dd77d839, only 2 of 5 phases) before this trail opened; opening a new trail via trail_runtime.py open silently overwrites the pointer - worth adding an explicit audit/reset subcommand (already queued in the original implementation plan, Phase 1) so a stale pointer is surfaced instead of quietly superseded.
next_seed: Build pmcro-csuite/ (12 Chiefs consolidated into agents/*.md) and dynamic-reasoning/ (35 reasoning strategies + selector agent) using the same migrated single-file convention validated in this trail. Resolve open questions 1 (pmcro/ top-level vs nested), 3 (selector always-invoked vs conditional), and 4 (AgentSkillsProvider roots) before or during that work.
stop_reason: pmcro/ package scope is complete and verified; csuite and dynamic-reasoning are substantially larger (12 and 35 files respectively) and were explicitly out of scope for this trail - natural stopping point before starting a second, larger migration.
